test_evidence.scope: stateless proposals, funding, capacity, runtime boundary and canonical configuration; no state advancement
the same 24 contracts from this exact extracted archive; not 24 additional cases

activation_changes: Canonical operating_stock=true; frozen consumer captures the completed selected-unit state.
At most two withheld fertilizer units for an existing actor and existing ongoing crops.
Value only final otherwise-unfunded consumption; incumbent carried/unsold stock is excluded from incremental benefit.
Reject unresolved same-day branch and include funding commitments through the full current day, even after a shorter service rejoin.
Require actual cash covering all same-day fixed spending plus 100 times the input-price scenario; no future sale credit.
Preserve all unit actions and market slot ordering; decline shared-allocation/capacity ambiguities.
limits: 100-unit rival-supply value and 100-times-input cash cushion are explicit policy heuristics.
Future watering, harvest/deposit execution, multiday operating cash, opponent behavior and final score remain unmeasured.
Historical input proposals are not newly executed candidate games.
